name: contexthub-sdk-typescript-workspace
description: Generation workspace for the ContextHub TypeScript SDK. Not the published package; that is generated into sdks/typescript.

scripts.spec:pull: mkdir -p openapi && curl -sS --fail --max-time 30 -o openapi/v1.yaml https://trycontexthub.com/v1/openapi.yaml && echo "fetched $(wc -c < openapi/v1.yaml) bytes"
